title: Mexican Tofu Tagine Tacos
description: A flavorful fusion of Mexican and North African cuisine, featuring crispy tacos filled with marinated tofu and tagine sauce.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and marinate in lime juice, cumin, chili powder, and acrid hot sauce (if using) for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp of oil in the skillet and cook the tofu until crispy on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat the algerian tagine over medium heat.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing the tofu onto a tortilla and spooning the tagine sauce over the top.
Serve with sliced avocado and additional hot sauce (if desired).
Garnish with cilantro, onion, and a squeeze of lime juice.
